from typing import Optional, List

class SearchResultsOutputModel(BaseModel):
    search_results: List[Dict] = Field(default=None, description="List of search results.")
    query_summary: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Response to customer.")
    model_config = Field(default=None, description="ConfigDict extra forbid", type="ConfigDict", extra="forbid")

# Retrieve cached attraction results
cached_attractions = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

    city="Las Vegas",
    num_people=5,
    budget=80,
    stars=[3, 3]
)

# Save hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)

# Find nearest scenic attractions to the hotels
nearest_results = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels,
    attractions=cached_attractions,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels_attractions", value=nearest_results)
